description: List the sensors and devices paired to a system — entry sensors, motion, glass break, smoke/CO, keypads, sirens and locks — with battery, offline and triggered status. Filter by type with `type_name` (e.g. "entry", "motion_v2", "lock").

force_update.description: Ask the base station to re-poll its devices first (slower). Defaults to false.

problems_only.description: Only return devices that are offline, low battery, or triggered.

sid.description: System id. Optional when the account has exactly one system; required when it has several.

type_name.description: Only return devices of this type name, e.g. "entry", "lock", "smoke".

name: simplisafe_list_sensors
